subject: Urgent: Q4 Roadmap & Budget Review
body:
Hi Simran,

I've been reviewing the Q4 projections and I'm concerned about the burn rate on the Phoenix project. We are currently 15% over budget.

I need you to do three things by the end of this week:
1. Review the attached AWS expense report and flag any anomalies.
2. Draft a revised timeline for the mobile app launch.
3. Schedule a sync with the engineering leads for next Monday.

Also, please let me know if we can cut the marketing spend for November. This is high priority.

Thanks,
Sarah

subject: Re: Deliverables for Phase 2
body:
Simran,

I just saw the latest build. Honestly, I'm not happy with the color palette—it doesn't match the brand guidelines we discussed last month. The blue is too dark and the font is hard to read on mobile.

We need these fixed before the stakeholder demo on Thursday. Can you please ensure the design team updates the CSS and pushes a new build by Wednesday noon? I don't want to be the one to tell the CEO the demo is delayed.

Regards,
Dave

subject: Policy Update: Remote Work Guidelines
